if.test: search != null and search != '' and search !='有效'

sql.if: AND ( sdl.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl2.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl3.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl4.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl5.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl6.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl7.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR sdl8.ITEM_VALUE like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR aaa.finprodMarketId like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR aaa.finprodAbbr like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR aaa.planIssueAmt ||''= #{search} OR to_char(aaa.planIssueAmt , 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '' = #{search} OR to_char(aaa.payEdate,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{search} OR to_char(aaa.payEdate,'yyyyMMdd') = #{search} OR aaa.issuePrice ||''= #{search} OR to_char(aaa.issuePrice , 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '' = #{search} OR aaa.referYieldStr ||''= #{search} OR to_char(aaa.firstConfirmDate,'yyyy-MM-dd') = #{search} OR to_char(aaa.firstConfirmDate,'yyyyMMdd') = #{search} OR aaa.minPamt ||''= #{search} OR to_char(aaa.minPamt , 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '' = #{search} OR aaa.maxPamt ||''= #{search} OR to_char(aaa.maxPamt , 'FM9999999999999990.9990') || '' = #{search} OR aaa.issueDateStr ||''= #{search} OR aaa.remark like '%' || #{search} || '%' )

mapper.sql:
SELECT '02' AS issueStage, SEC_INFO.SEC_ID finprodMarketId, SEC_INFO.BOND_ABBREVIATION finprodAbbr, NULL AS finprodId, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_METHOD , RELEASE_INFO.ISSUING_METHOD) AS issueClass, trunc(nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_SIZE), 2) AS planIssueAmt, nvl(to_date(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd') , RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE) AS issueDateStart, nvl(to_date(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'), RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE) AS issueDateEnd, nvl(to_date(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'), RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE) AS payEdate, SEC_INFO.VARIETY_OF_COUPONS couponSpecies, SEC_INFO.RATE_TYPE intType, nvl(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX, RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_PX) AS issuePrice, nvl(to_char(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE * 100 , 'FM9999999999999990.9990') , to_char(RELEASE_INFO.COUPON_RATE * 100 , 'FM9999999999999990.9990')) || ' %' AS referYieldStr, nvl(to_date(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'), RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE) AS firstConfirmDate, nvl(ROUND(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT,2), ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.MIN_PER_TENDER_AMT, 2)) AS minPamt, nvl(ROUND(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT,2), ROUND(RELEASE_INFO.MAX_PER_TENDER_AMT, 2)) AS maxPamt, SEC_INFO.TRADING_PLACES tradeMarket, SEC_INFO.ISSUER AS issuer, SEC_INFO.CURRENCY ccy, SEC_INFO.PRIMARY_CLASSIFICATION type9, SEC_INFO.SECONDARY_CLASSIFICATION type10, NULL AS type11, RDI_RELEASE_INFO.REMARK AS remark, RELEASE_INFO.BIDDING_METHOD AS tenderType, RELEASE_INFO.RELEASE_TYPE AS issueStyle, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS issueDateStr, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.EVENT_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR( RELEASE_INFO.PAYMENT_DEADLINE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS payEdateStr, nvl(TO_CHAR(RDI_RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(RELEASE_INFO.INTEREST_ACCRUAL_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS firstConfirmDateStr
FROM INTERF_WIND_UNRELEASE_SEC_INFO SEC_INFO LEFT JOIN INTERF_WIND_RELEASE_INFO RELEASE_INFO ON SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = RELEASE_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN INTERF_RDI_RELEASE_INFO RDI_RELEASE_INFO ON RDI_RELEASE_INFO.SECURITY_ID = SEC_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD on SEC_INFO.ISSUER = CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD.INSITITUTE_CODE LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO CUSTOMER_INFO on CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD.CUSTOMER_ID = CUSTOMER_INFO.CUSTOMER_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT on SEC_INFO.SEC_ID = PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
SEC_INFO.TRADING_PLACES in ('01','02','03','04') AND ( CASE WHEN RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN RELEASE_INFO.LISTING_DATE -1 WHEN RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN RELEASE_INFO.ISSUE_DATE END >= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') )

SELECT CASE WHEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') or ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE >= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '01' WHEN PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE > TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '02'
ELSE NULL END AS issueStage, PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as finprodMarketId, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodAbbr, PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS as issueClass, round(ISSUE.PLAN_ISSUE_AMT/100000000,2) as planIssueAmt, case when ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS ='01' THEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE else nvl(ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE,ISSUE.TENDER_SDATE) end as issueDateStart, case when ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS ='01' THEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE else nvl(ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE,ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE) end as issueDateEnd, nvl(ISSUE.PAY_EDATE, ISSUE.PAY_DATE) AS payEdate, PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES as couponSpecies, ISSUE.INT_TYPE as intType, ISSUE.ISSUE_PRICE as issuePrice, case when PRODUCT.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' AND ISSUE.INT_TYPE = '02' THEN SDLDATA.ITEM_VALUE || '+' || to_char(ISSUE.bp * 10000 ,'FM9999999999999990.90') || ' BP' else to_char(ISSUE.REFER_YIELD * 100 ,'FM9999999999999990.9990') || ' %' end as referYieldStr, ISSUE.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE firstConfirmDate, nvl(round(ISSUE.MIN_PER_TAMT / 100000000, 2), round(ISSUE.MIN_PAMT / 100000000, 2)) AS minPamt, nvl(round(ISSUE.MAX_PER_UTAMT / 100000000, 2), round(ISSUE.MAX_PAMT / 100000000, 2)) AS maxPamt, PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET as tradeMarket, PRODUCT.ISSUER as issuer, PRODUCT.CCY as ccy, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_9 as type9, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_10 as type10, PRODUCT_TYPE.TYPE_11 as type11, PRODUCT.REMARK as remark, ISSUE.TENDER_TYPE as tenderType, ISSUE.ISSUE_STYLE as issueStyle, case when ISSUE.ISSUE_CLASS ='01' THEN to_char(ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') when ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE is not null then to_char(ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || '~' || to_char(ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') else to_char(ISSUE.TENDER_SDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') || '~' || to_char(ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') end as issueDateStr, nvl(TO_CHAR(ISSUE.PAY_EDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), TO_CHAR(ISSUE.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) AS payEdateStr, TO_CHAR(ISSUE.FIRST_CONFIRM_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as firstConfirmDateStr
FROM FIN_PRODUCT PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD PRODUCT_ADD ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_ADD.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE ISSUE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = ISSUE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE PRODUCT_TYPE ON PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = PRODUCT_TYPE.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_INT_RATE_INFO miri ON miri.INT_RATE_ID = ISSUE.INT_RATE_ID AND miri.EFF_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') LEFT JOIN (select * from SYS_DATADICT_LIST where DICT_CODE='SECRATE_DATA') SDLDATA on ISSUE.INT_RATE_ID = SDLDATA.ITEM_CODE
PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET in ('01','02','03','04') AND (PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS != '02' OR PRODUCT_ADD.ISSUE_STATUS IS NULL ) AND ( CASE WHEN PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN PRODUCT_ADD.LISTING_DATE -1 WHEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN ISSUE.ISSUE_DATE WHEN ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE IS NOT NULL THEN ISSUE.TENDER_EDATE END >= TO_DATE(#{platformDate},'YYYY-MM-DD') )

ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, PRICE price, IS_ACCURATE isAccurate, INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerId, CALENDAR_ID calendarId, REMARK remark, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime, CHL_ID chlId, SALE_CODE saleCode, PRICE_MODEL priceModel, ENTRUST_TYPE entrustType, STOCK_ID stockId, ENTRUST_CLASS entrustClass ,BUSINESS_MODEL businessModel from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select ENTRUST_ID entrustId, SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId from ETR_ENTRUST_ADD where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION select ENTRUST_ID entrustId, SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId from WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BID_PRICE bidPrice, BID_PRIN_AMT bidPrinAmt, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime, PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId FROM ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION SELECT ENTRUST_ID entrustId, BID_PRICE bidPrice, BID_PRIN_AMT bidPrinAmt, CREATE_USER createUser, CREATE_DEPT createDept, CREATE_TIME createTime, UPDATE_USER updateUser, UPDATE_TIME updateTime, PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_BID_PRICE where ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
